title: Gas Gaps in the Protoplanetary Disk around the Young Protostar HL Tau
question: Do the millimeter continuum gaps in the HL Tau disk have counterparts in the HCO+ (1-0) gas, and what do the gas gap widths and depths imply for their origin?

what.value: 3 mm continuum image and continuum gap/ring radii (D2, D5, D6, B5, B6)

evidence.quote: We retrieved the 3 mm continuum image directly from the ALMA data archive

what.value: Disk inclination 47 deg and position angle 138 deg

evidence.quote: The disk around HL Tau is inclined by 47$\ensuremath{^\circ}$ from the plane of the sky, and its major axis has a position angle of 138$\ensuremath{^\circ}$ from north to east (cite: ALMA15).

recipe.method: Fourier transform of calibrated visibilities in CASA, no CLEAN, HCO+ continuum-subtracted

recipe.goal: Azimuthally averaged radial HCO+ intensity profile
recipe.method: Deprojected with i=47 deg, PA=138 deg; bins of half beam (~0.035''); pixels within ±45 deg of major axis; integrate 2-12 km/s excluding absorption and ±1 sigma channels
key_parameters: uncertainty = sqrt(N_int) x sigma x dv

recipe.goal: Derive continuum optical depth and HCO+ column density
recipe.method: T from CO brightness temperature without continuum subtraction; tau_3mm from radiative transfer; correct HCO+ for continuum optical depth; column density from Mangum & Shirley formula
assumptions: dust and gas thermally coupled with the same temperature; HCO+ thermalized; CO+continuum optically thick

recipe.method: Power law fit near each gap, subtract, Gaussian fit to gap for FWHM and central column density; contrast vs power law

recipe.goal: Estimate planet masses from gap depth
recipe.method: Kanagawa15 gap formula using derived temperature and depths

evidence.quote: Both HCO$^+$ gaps have similar FWHM widths of $\sim$14$\pm$7 AU.

answer_key.quantity: HCO+ column density in inner gap
HCO+ column density in outer gap

answer_key.value: 0.8 MJ at 28 AU; 2.1 MJ at 69 AU

evidence.quote: planet masses of $\sim$0.8 $M_J$ at $\sim$28 AU and $\sim$2.1 $M_J$ at $\sim$69 AU

not_stated_but_needed: Spectral window and execution block selection from the SV data set
uvcontsub line-free channels and fit order
Line-free channels for noise estimation in averaged spectra
Exact radial range used for the power-law fits near each gap
Continuum image and its beam used for tau_3mm
Whether the CO cube was primary-beam corrected
score_reason: Public data and a clear method, but several imaging and fitting details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, a fairly clear recipe, and numeric results.
